endpoints.desc: Initiates a LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning process on the local GPU.

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {
    "base_model": "llama-3-8b-instruct",
    "dataset_path": "/workspace/dataset.jsonl",
    "epochs": 3,
    "learning_rate": 0.0002
}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/v1/tuning/start', json=payload)
print(res.json())
